name: YouTube Premium Student
summary: A discounted YouTube Premium membership for verified university students in Australia.
who: Students at a SheerID-approved higher education institution in a country with student plans, including Australia.
how: Go to youtube.com/premium/student and select Get Premium.
Verify with SheerID. If it isn't instant, upload documents for a manual check.
Add a payment method and buy.
catches: You can keep it for up to four years, re-verifying each year.
Cancel any paid YouTube membership before switching.
We couldn't confirm the Australian price, so none is shown.
